findings.note: Townsend is listed among the sponsors of HB 215, the Voter List Integrity Act (sponsor list read on policyrisk.com/state-bill/GA-HB215-2025-2026; bill text, committee substitute LC 47 3419S, read at the URL). The substitute bars the Secretary of State and local election officials from taking part in multistate voter list maintenance organizations and lets the state enter voter list maintenance compacts with other states. Hopper date 1/30/2025; recommitted 4/4/2025.
